group.registration.label: Registration
group.registration.meaning: Keep the accepted registration facts or replace all seven registration inputs together.
group.decision.label: Payment decision
group.decision.meaning: Keep the accepted decision, replace its complete date, amount, and currency tuple, or clear it.
group.payment.label: Payment record
group.payment.meaning: Keep the accepted payment record, replace its date, or clear the recorded payment date; clearing does not reverse an external transfer.
